duplicate-fns-rule.desc: Verifies that there are no duplicate functions anywhere in the codebase. See the `duplicate-logic` rule also.
duplicate-fns-rule.equivalence: Two functions are duplicates when one can be turned into the other by renaming identifiers, one-for-one (a "p-match", or Type-2 clone).
duplicate-fns-rule.exemption: Methods in `impl Trait for Type` blocks, since the trait dictates their shape and the resulting boilerplate is unavoidable.
